parameters.name: unit

set protocols cfm domain CFM md md3 ma m.template: set protocols cfm domain [parameter1] md [parameter2] ma [parameter3] mep [parameter4] remote-mep [parameter5] test-id [parameter6] delay-measure one-way send interval [parameter7]
